claims.text: Yes, there is a liability cap. Section 9 caps either party's liability at the total amount actually paid by Corio for the transaction to which the liability relates, during the 12 months before the cause of the liability. Liability under Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3 is excluded from this cap.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 2.7, 8, 10 AND 12.3 OF THIS          AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR          RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE          EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE          TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12)          MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE CAUSE OF

claims.text: A second, aggregate limit in the same Section 9 caps liability at the total amount actually paid by Corio under the Agreement to Changepoint, with the same carve-out for Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3.

citations.quote: THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO UNDER THIS          AGREEMENT TO CHANGEPOINT.
EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER          SECTIONS 2.7, 8, 10 AND 12.3 OF THIS AGREEMENT

claims.text: Changepoint's entire liability for breach or default is capped at amounts listed as (I) to (IV), including the amount paid for the Licensed Materials and, in aggregate, the total amount paid by the customer under the Agreement. The cap does not apply to claims for breach of Section 5.2 (unauthorized disclosure of confidential information) or Section 6.4(a) (intellectual property indemnity).

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR ANY CLAIM FOR BREACH OF SECTION 5.2 (UNAUTHORIZED DISCLOSURE OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION), OR FOR BREACH OF SECTION 6.4(A) (INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY INDEMNITY), CHANGEPOINT'S ENTIRE LIABILITY
(IV) IN THE AGGREGATE WITH RESPECT TO ALL CLAIMS UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT, THE AMOUNT PAID BY CUSTOMER UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

claims.text: Excluded from liability, with no cap stated: special, incidental, indirect or consequential loss or damage, lost business revenue, loss of profits, and loss of data. Changepoint is liable only as expressly provided in the Agreement, including for negligence.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL CHANGEPOINT BE LIABLE FOR SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, OR CONSEQUENTIAL LOSS OR DAMAGE, LOST BUSINESS REVENUE, LOSS OF PROFITS, LOSS OF DATA

CHANGEPOINT SHALL BE LIABLE TO CUSTOMER AS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED IN THIS AGREEMENT BUT SHALL HAVE NO OTHER OBLIGATION, DUTY, OR LIABILITY WHATSOEVER IN CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE TO CUSTOMER INCLUDING ANY LIABILITY FOR NEGLIGENCE.

claims.text: Section 9 also excludes either party's liability for lost profits or costs of procurement of substitute goods or services, and for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, with the same carve-out for Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL          EITHER PARTY HAVE ANY LIABILITY TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY LOST          PROFITS OR COSTS OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES, OR          FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTIAL, SPECIAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

claims.text: A different provision, apparently in an end-user agreement with Corio rather than this Agreement, caps Changepoint's liability for direct and other damages at the fee paid by the end user under that agreement. The sources do not say which provision governs.

citations.quote: CHANGEPOINT'S, LIABILITY UNDER SUCH AGREEMENT FOR DIRECT,       INDIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL AND/OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND,       INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, RESTITUTION, WILL NOT, IN ANY EVENT, EXCEED       THE FEE PAID BY END USER TO CHANGEPOINT UNDER SUCH AGREEMENT.
